senses.gloss:
प्रफर्वी प्रफर्वी, f., Ved. a wanton or
lascivious girl.

प्रफुल्त प्र-फुल्त, अस्, आ, अम्, blown, blos-
somed, blooming (= प्र-फुल्ल, Scholiast on Pāṇ.
VII. 4, 89).

प्र-फुल्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, blooming forth, blooming,
blossoming, flowering, blossomed, blown (as a flower),
covered with blossoms; expanded like a blown
flower; shining; smiling; glad, gay, cheerful, pleased.
—प्रफुल्ल-नयन or प्रफुल्ल-नेत्र, अस्, आ,
अम्, having full or sparkling eyes, having eyes ex-
panded with joy.
—प्रफुल्ल-वदन, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the face expanded with joy, having a cheerful
or smiling countenance, looking gay or happy.
